title: refactor: simplify image provider adapters and legacy utilities
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Centralizes Replicate error mapping, Pruna's shared DeepInfra generation flow, and OpenRouter request transport while preserving provider-specific inputs, errors, billing, and retry behavior.
- Removes the unreachable direct Vertex AI image client, generator, and tests after NanoBanana moved to OpenRouter.
- Replaces the handwritten image base64 decoder with Buffer while preserving accepted data URI, whitespace, unpadded, URL-safe, and invalid-character behavior.
- Removes obsolete scalar/null branches from normalized image adapters, processes Flux Klein references directly, and keeps Nova Canvas's tested direct-call tolerance.
- Deletes 1,078 net lines with no remaining references to the removed Vertex utilities.

Checks:
- Gen TypeScript typecheck
- Biome on all changed production files
- Exact donor-content comparison for the four surviving normalization files
- Repository reference scan and `git diff --check`
- Component branches previously passed 207, 47, and 15 focused image checks respectively; the combined full-suite rerun could not collect because another worktree held the fixed snapshot-server port 3210 (no test failure)

gist.headline: The adapter garden pruned
gist.blurb: The image stack got a careful trim: shared provider paths now do the repetitive lifting, while the old Vertex shed has been cleared out. Same pixels, fewer mysterious vines.
gist.summary: Centralized Replicate error mapping, Pruna's shared DeepInfra generation flow, and OpenRouter transport; replaced the custom base64 decoder with Buffer; and removed 1,078 net lines of unreachable Vertex AI image utilities after NanoBanana moved to OpenRouter.
gist.impact: Image providers retain their existing inputs, error handling, billing, retry behavior, and normalization tolerance while the generation codebase has fewer duplicate paths to maintain.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends a cozy garden of labeled image-provider pipes feeding a retro image terminal, while neatly composting an unused old Vertex AI tool shed. The shared pipe junction represents centralized transport and error handling; small code-plants and flowers show that the visible generation garden keeps growing normally.
